title: Bootstrap locked application and acceptance adapter
acceptance: Inspect maintained dependency source/licenses; pin supported Python/Node/images and package lockfiles. Implement real dev/lint/test/migrate commands and JSON adapter protocol; missing code must fail. No app component performs paid calls.

title: Demonstrate real historical Cape-to-Maryland case
acceptance: Within three-day investigation parse pinned index/series/events/licenses; choose supported Cape historical mission and independently supported route. Document variant/stage/datum/emission compatibility, separate held-out mission from template creation; calculate Baltimore and near-pad windows with independent geometry <=0.1deg. Publish uncertainty and data gate result. Synthetic positive/archived telemetry alone cannot pass.

title: Attempt upcoming Cape mission and re-estimate remaining build
acceptance: After historical demonstration (or explicit blocked historical gate), fetch one upcoming Cape launch within free budgets; exact route/profile association or honest unsupported report. Overlay NWS at21201 and record uncertain source coverage. Record approach viability; continue T04-T21 even when route gate blocks release. No schedule-only completion.

title: Schedule adapter, versioning and budgets
acceptance: Normalize actual external2.3 fields and precision/status enums; post-filter Cape pads; completed result from upcoming endpoint never treated as future. Cache central30m/5m, requests<=12 rolling/hour including pages/retries. Unknown status,403/429/timeouts and source changes tested.

title: Route registry and historical compatibility
acceptance: Approve only tested source formats; exact mission/pad/attempt+validity, distinguish hazards/path/guidance/observations; block ambiguous branches/doglegs/unknown datum/variant. Pin immutable assets/licenses; retain raw failures. Do not copy conflicted NOTAM parser. Stage switches and absent burns tested.

title: NWS and location normalization
acceptance: Use actual pipe-delimited Census headers, preserve ZIP string, manual/GPS confirm and timezone. NWS points returned grid, ISO durations/units/fetch+issue/valid coverage, daily point and per-cell cache; missing total unsupported, missing visibility disclosed.100-location quota defined.

title: Geometry and correlated envelopes
acceptance: WGS84 ECEF/ENU/occultation independently checked;5s samples with<=15s gaps; >=20s luminous duration and first burns only. Circular sectors/rounding/zenith/movement and complete-negative limits; no simulators/return burn/TLE.

title: Astronomy, clocks and window alternatives
acceptance: Pin DE421 asset/hash/coverage, zone data and solar conventions; USNO within120s. Shadow/active emission, twilight, polar nulls, DST/folds/gaps, observer-local dates. Enumerate alternative times and one-minute transitions; slipped launch recomputes.

title: Combine weather and advice with provenance
acceptance: Implement ordered rules and exact thresholds, qualifying subintervals, freshness; recon<=Possible, official inclusion+time+clear/fresh required for Worth. Incomplete data cannot prove negative. Every input revision invalidates cache/jobs and archives old result.

title: Database and API ownership contracts
acceptance: Schema migrations/constraints, immutable snapshots/revisions, read/private DTO split; implement every OpenAPI endpoint and error, pagination/cursors/ETag/If-Match/idempotency. Session capability+CSRF, authorization, quota and malformed inputs tested.

title: Durable jobs, cache and computation orchestration
acceptance: Leader/budget locks, jobs unique/leased/restart-safe, cache includes all hashes and runtime freshness; no per-user polling; crash/retry/disk-full paths preserve old snapshots, clock injection. Schedule changes invalidate before notice claim.

title: Security, admin and privacy lifecycle
acceptance: Protected authenticated admin disable/retry/audit; no direct production row edits. SSRF/input/CSRF/ownership tests; secrets/log redaction. Immediate unsubscribe and <=24h erasure with backup tombstones,30d logs.

title: Location and launch browsing
acceptance: Responsive location confirm/GPS/manual and local-date launch grouping; browser travel zone ignored, DST offsets explicit; exact/window/date/unknown and terminal states; all loading/empty/error/stale/unsupported states accessible.

title: Viewing guidance, sources and conditions
acceptance: SVG approximate union sky band+table; direction/movement/max elevation/source uncertainty; official-only fields source supported; hazard mode no timed path. Sunrise/transitions/weather bins/subintervals, missing/stale explanations and provenance visible.

title: Subscriptions, history, privacy and observations UI
acceptance: Preview local send times/suppression; opt-ins default off, calendar snapshot warning, corrections history, immediate unsubscribe/deletion and admin errors. Observation links archived forecast and allows inconclusive/not_attempted.

title: Notification state machine and race safety
acceptance: Implement exact milestone/expiry/quiet/threshold/opt-in/revision rules; no past milestones; >=5m accumulated shift/local-date/scrub corrections;10min debounce except immediate window. PostgreSQL two-worker, revision/unsubscribe race and restart tests.

title: ICS, operational metrics and optional delivery boundary
acceptance: RFC5545 snapshot UID/SEQUENCE/time escaping tested; no automatic correction claim. Metrics/health/admin queue. Email remains disabled by default; if enabled require actual free existing provider, verified address/consent, idempotency/reconcile/timeout tests. No paid fallback.

title: Existing hardware deployment, backup and recovery
acceptance: Pinned nonroot containers, migrations, proxy HTTPS on existing reachable infrastructure or local-only documented. Daily encrypted off-host backup to existing storage; isolation restore <=4h objective and RPO24h, purge tombstones before serves/sends. Disk-full/crash recovery verified.

title: Complete application release regression
acceptance: Run every112+fixture,16 stories, real independent geometry and sunrise, real historical Cape/profile/route gate and official guidance. Live unavailable =>blocked, not pass; no fake/mock transport release. Trace requirements and missing proof; preserve raw logs.

title: Full ensemble load and release recovery exercise
acceptance: Benchmark100 confirmed points, two-stage15min profiles at5s including all admitted correlated candidates. Measure cached p95<2s after warmup, uncached cost/memory, source budgets and queue lag. Report ensemble size/hardware/data; synthetic load cannot satisfy G-REAL. Re-run restore on deployment artifact.

title: Prospective pilot and coverage evaluation
acceptance: Archive actual issued forecasts before launch and forecast-time weather; collect5 launches/30 labeled attempts including misses/inconclusive; publish supported/all-Cape denominators, false positives and missed sightings with evidence limitations. No feedback is not negative; Possible cap remains until separately justified rules change. Optional OCR/multiple profiles only after rights/validation.
